# DroneSpray

> DroneSpray makes pre-mixing and refilling systems for agricultural spraying drones: units that prepare the spray solution in the field and refill the drone in minutes. Made by FARMA Kyratsas Agricultural Machinery (FARMA Κυράτσας Γεωργικά Μηχανήματα Ε.Ε.) in Larissa, Greece. CE and UKCA certified. Sold in Greece and exported across Europe through a partner network.

Website: https://www.dronespray-premixingsystems.com/ (Greek, English, German, Spanish, Italian, French; choose the language at the top right)
Catalogue (PDF): https://www.dronespray-premixingsystems.com/files/DroneSpray-Catalogue-2026.pdf
Contact: +30 2410 622500 · WhatsApp +30 698 325 4053 · info@farma.com.gr · Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00
Address: 3rd km Larissa – Karditsa road, 41500 Larissa, Greece

## Models

All units have a polyethylene tank on a metal frame, continuous dual agitation, a rotating tank rinse nozzle, a chemical container rinsing system, a Camlock coupling, a 3/4" hose with filling gun, a control unit, a glycerine pressure gauge and a level indicator.

- DS600: 600 L tank, 1 HP stainless (INOX) centrifugal pump, up to 80 L/min, 220 V. 175 × 70 × 150 cm, 160 kg. The largest tank in the range.
- DS500: 500 L tank, 1 HP stainless centrifugal pump, up to 80 L/min. 150 × 100 × 115 cm, 100 kg. Temporarily unavailable.
- DS420 Cone: 420 L conical tank for complete draining, 1 HP stainless centrifugal pump, up to 80 L/min. 90 × 80 × 126 cm, 80 kg.
- DS400: 400 L tank on a compact metal panel with a side battery box. 151 × 68 × 140 cm, 135 kg. New model.
- DS300: 300 L tank, 1 HP stainless centrifugal pump, up to 80 L/min. 140 × 48.5 × 139 cm, 90 kg.
- DS200: 200 L tank, 1 HP stainless centrifugal pump, up to 80 L/min. 140 × 48.5 × 127 cm, 80 kg.
- DS200 Cone: 200 L conical tank, 1 HP stainless centrifugal pump, up to 80 L/min. 78 × 57 × 135 cm, 50 kg. The lightest unit.
- DS110 Cone: 110 L conical tank, 12 V diaphragm pump, up to 19 L/min, runs from a 12 V battery with no 220 V power needed in the field.
- External Pre-Mixer 20 L: standalone pre-mixing unit with its own 1 HP stainless centrifugal pump, up to 60 L/min, 220 V. 70 × 40 × 45 cm. Also optional equipment for the DS600 and DS420.

## Optional equipment and accessories

External pre-mixers (20, 25, 26, 35, 37, 45 L), 1.5 HP and 2 HP stainless centrifugal pumps, automatic refuelling hose reel 1" (10/15 m), tank lid mixer, powder dispersion and bottle rinsing system, digital refuelling nozzle, digital flow meter 1", electrical control panel, 12 V diaphragm pump (6.2 bar, 20 L/min), adjustable bracket for the external pre-mixer, water-sensitive spray paper for checking spray coverage (26 × 76 mm, packs of 50), automatic tank lid (Ø367 and Ø462 mm), LED work lights, reinforced transport wheels with brake.

## Dealers and partners

DroneSpray looks for dealers in Greece and abroad: agricultural drone resellers, drone spraying service providers, agricultural machinery dealers and farm supply distributors. Export countries include Spain, Italy, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Croatia and Latvia. Apply on the website under "Become a dealer".
